_approach: Bar 1 plays the normal 2/4 clap groove; bar 2 keeps the beat-2 clap, then stutters into a rapid climbing roll from beat 3 through the end (60 to 110), while the hats drop out halfway through the bar to let the stutter cut through, closing on a crash. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
